settings.heading: Born from a Korean beauty ritual
settings.text:
YUMI began with a simple frustration: after 50, foundation stopped working with our skin. It oxidised, settled into lines and never quite matched.

So we looked to Korea — where skincare and makeup are one, and where fermented, skin-loving ingredients have been trusted for generations. We spent years perfecting a single colour-changing formula that adapts to your tone as you blend, cares for mature skin, and finishes like your skin, only better.
